title: A filter argument of an inline CALCULATE is evaluated before the context transition
query: EVALUATE ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( 'Product'[Product] ), "x", CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], ALL ( 'Product' ), VALUES ( 'Product'[Color] ) ) )

source.quote: The filter arguments of CALCULATE and CALCULATETABLE do not receive the effect of a context transition.
source.supports: the filter argument VALUES ( Product[Color] ) does not see the filter made by the context transition

source.quote: CALCULATE evaluates all the explicit filter arguments in the original evaluation context, each one independently from the others.
source.supports: filter arguments are evaluated in the original evaluation context

derivation: The original filter context is empty, so VALUES ( Product[Color] ) is Red, Blue, Green on every row. The transition filters Product[Product]; ALL ( Product ) removes that filter; the color filter allows every color. Each row is the grand total 540.
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
